repository.name: @webex/storage-adapter-local-forage
repository.purpose: A localforage-backed (IndexedDB first) implementation of the Webex storage-adapter interface, published to npm so a browser host can persist Webex JS SDK storage namespaces across page reloads and browser restarts.

public_interfaces.name: package exports
public_interfaces.audience: Webex JS SDK hosts that assign the adapter to a storage slot (in this workspace, @webex/recipe-private-web-client as storage.unboundedAdapter) and external npm consumers; driven at runtime by the @webex/webex-core storage layer.
public_interfaces.notes: Verify names against src/index.js and the compatibility commitments against the Public surface and Export stability sections of src/docs/README.md. Constructor arguments are ignored.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.audience: Contributors and CI jobs operating on this package from the workspace root.
public_interfaces.notes: There is no test:unit or test:integration script, so the aggregate test script cannot succeed. test:browser runs Karma with Mocha and cannot load the shared Jest-style suite; it is not the canonical unit-test command.

glossary.definition: The object bind(namespace, options) resolves; it exposes get, put, del, and clear for one namespace.
glossary.notes: A new binding is created on every bind call; the webex-core storage layer caches one per namespace.

glossary.definition: The record key actually stored in localforage: the namespace, a slash, then the caller's key.
glossary.notes: It is the only isolation between namespaces, because all bindings share the default database.

glossary.definition: A record whose value is null; get resolves it with null.
glossary.notes: Contrast with a missing key, which rejects with NotFoundError.

glossary.definition: The Webex SDK storage slot for data without a size bound; the in-repo host assigns this adapter to it.
glossary.notes: The encryption plugin caches serialized KMS keys in unbounded storage.

evidence_rules.requirement: Never ship a template placeholder in a generated document; replace it with verified package evidence or surface the gap as a blocking question.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not assume clear() is scoped to one namespace.
negative_guidance.why: It calls localforage.clear() on the default instance and erases every record on the origin; the owner classified this as a known hazard on 2026-10-06.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not assume the constructor argument isolates storage.
negative_guidance.why: The constructor takes no parameters; every instance shares the default localforage database.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat a green test or CI run as evidence of adapter behavior.
negative_guidance.why: No automated test executes this module: the suite is skipped in Node and cannot load under Karma with Mocha.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change the stored key format, database, or store name without a migration.
negative_guidance.why: Records persist in users' browsers across releases and would be orphaned.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not cite commit or pull-request history as rationale.
negative_guidance.why: The owner excluded git history as evidence for this onboarding.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not copy Repo Standards templates into this package.
negative_guidance.why: The owner chose to share the workspace-root template snapshot instead of a package-level copy.

high.expectation: The claim is backed by src/index.js and the affected specification sections are updated in the same change.

medium.expectation: Implementation evidence exists but no test observes the behavior; record the gap in Verification rather than claiming coverage.

low.expectation: Neither code nor a dependency spec establishes the fact; stop and ask the package owner.
